functions.name: persist_run_key
functions.decompiled_code: LONG persist_run_key(void) { HKEY key; RegCreateKeyExW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, L\"Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\", 0, NULL, 0, KEY_SET_VALUE, NULL, &key, NULL); RegSetValueExW(key, L\"ExampleApp\", 0, REG_SZ, (const BYTE *)L\"C:\\Example\\example.exe\", 46); return 0; }
